title: This One, That One: Contrasting ez and az

sections.content: ez and az can each stand alone as the subject of a sentence, pointing at two different things being compared. Used together with de, they set up a direct contrast between 'this one' and 'that one'.

items.english: This one is ugly, but that one is pretty.
This one is comfortable, but that one isn't.

sections.content: Notice 'de az nem' drops the adjective entirely -- Hungarian, like English, can leave the second half of a contrast understood rather than repeating the whole adjective.
